PLAN "Prenatal Strength Programme - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

  GOAL secondary pelvic_stability:
    name "Support core, pelvic floor, and posterior chain stability"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:

          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body and Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          cat_cow 1m
        main straight_sets:
